title: KafkaTemplate.send in a @Transactional method fails with 'No transaction is in process' on Boot 4
errorSample:
java.lang.IllegalStateException: No transaction is in process; possible solutions: run the template operation within the scope of a template.executeInTransaction() operation, start a transaction with @Transactional before invoking the template method, run in a transaction started by a listener container when consuming a record
	at org.springframework.util.Assert.state(Assert.java:80)
	at org.springframework.kafka.core.KafkaTemplate.getTheProducer(KafkaTemplate.java:975)
	at org.springframework.kafka.core.KafkaTemplate.doSend(KafkaTemplate.java:849)
	at org.springframework.kafka.core.KafkaTemplate.observeSend(KafkaTemplate.java:826)
	at org.springframework.kafka.core.KafkaTemplate.send(KafkaTemplate.java:607)
	at task.OrderEventPublisher.publishAll(Application.kt:22)
	at task.OrderEventPublisherTests.발행한 이벤트는 커밋되어 모두 전송된다(OrderEventPublisherTests.kt:64)
symptom: Sending from a method annotated with @Transactional throws IllegalStateException "No transaction is in process; possible solutions: run the template operation within the scope of a template.executeInTransaction() operation, start a transaction with @Transactional ...", although spring.kafka.producer.transaction-id-prefix is set.
cause: The transactional producer factory is only wired into the template when the Kafka listener infrastructure is enabled and the producer is configured for exactly-once semantics. Without @EnableKafka and with default producer settings, the template falls back to a non-transactional producer and rejects the send.
fixSummary: Annotate the application class with @EnableKafka and configure the producer for exactly-once: spring.kafka.producer.acks=all, spring.kafka.producer.properties.enable.idempotence=true and spring.kafka.producer.properties.max.in.flight.requests.per.connection=1.
